review.why: Gives a quick-start path for brand voice, SEO blog posts, social content and calendars, with two helper scripts and reference guides.
review.summary: Three entry points (brand voice, blog, social) and workflows to set a voice from existing content, write keyword-optimized posts and plan a monthly calendar with a 40/25/25/10 pillar split. Two Python scripts report voice profile, readability and an SEO score. Frameworks and platform guidance sit in reference files; a KPI list runs from content to business metrics.
strengths: Builds a voice baseline from the brand's existing content
Clear order of work, from audience need to proofreading
Metrics span content, engagement and business results
cautions: Most of the method is in reference files not read here
Keyword density and search volume targets are generic rules of thumb
The grep command offered to check voice does not test voice at all
